SHOT: A three-quarter profile portrait, the ear nearest camera sharp and centred, hair tucked behind it, the earring legible in frame. 4:5 vertical, full bleed.

CROP: The frame is cut straight across just ABOVE THE UPPER LIP. NO eyes, NO eyebrows, NO forehead anywhere in this picture. Inside the frame: the ear, the jaw, the cheek below the nose, the neck, the collarbone and the shoulder. A cropped beauty detail, NOT a portrait.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is our approved packshot of this exact piece and the ONLY authority on what it is: copy its construction, proportions, metal colour and stone colour EXACTLY; ignore its cube and its background. IMAGE 1 is a close view, so the piece's SIZE in this picture comes ONLY from the SCALE TEST below. IMAGE 2 is the authority on the model, skin, garment, hair, ground and light: match it exactly, but she wears ONLY the piece from IMAGE 1, worn in the earlobe: EXACTLY ONE earring in this ear, through a single piercing, never two earrings stacked on the same ear; any other jewellery in IMAGE 2 is removed.

THE PLATE: A young Indian woman, late twenties, warm mid-brown skin with golden undertones. Long dark brown hair in loose natural waves. Bare shoulders, marigold-saffron silk camisole with narrow spaghetti straps. Nails short, bare, pale nude, no polish colour. Warm cream seamless with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: A PAIR OF CHUNKY TEARDROP HOOPS: each earring is a thick, puffed, high-polish gold tone hoop shaped like a long teardrop in side view, narrow at the top where it enters the lobe and swelling to a rounded bulb at the bottom, open at the back with a hinged snap. At its lower back edge ONE clear PEAR-cut stone in three fine gold claws sits beside the hoop, point up, so the stone peeks out next to the hoop's lower end. Exactly one stone per earring, a clear pear, point up; the hoop is smooth polished metal, never textured, never pave; a teardrop profile, never a round hoop; no ear cuff.

SCALE TEST: On the lobe the hoop is as long as the earlobe is wide (about 18mm) and about a third of the ear's height, narrow where it enters the lobe; the pear is about a third of the hoop's length and sits beside the hoop's lower half, its bottom no lower than the hoop's bottom; never larger. The jewellery keeps its true small size against the body; it is read by bringing the camera closer, never by making the piece bigger.

ABSENCE LIST: No eyes, no eyebrows, no forehead. No second piece of jewellery, no watch, no other rings, no other earrings, no necklace unless it is the product. No nail polish colour. No props, no flowers. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. The picture runs edge to edge as a crisp, clean, modern digital studio photograph, shot today on a high-resolution digital camera.
